# Bubble Invest — AI Agents, Research & Consulting

> We build AI agents for investment, security, and content management. We share everything: free blog, newsletter, available agents, and premium research reports. We also deploy AI agents for finance professionals and SMEs in France.

## What We Do

### For Everyone (B2C)
We build AI agents and share them publicly. Our blog, newsletter, and tools are free. Premium research reports and agent subscriptions are available in our shop.

- **AI Agents**: Portfolio Manager (coming soon), Security Agent (Sentinel, 29 EUR/mo), Community Manager (coming soon)
- **Research Reports**: In-depth stock analysis with scoring, investable theses, risk assessment (7.99-12.99 EUR each)
- **Free Content**: Blog, newsletter, Substack articles on AI, investing, and economics
- **Build in Public**: Every decision documented — what works, what breaks, how we fix it

### For Professionals (B2B)
We install AI agents (Claude Code) directly on your machine. Quick Start Pack: 2,000 EUR, 3 sessions, operational in 3 weeks.

- Quick Start Pack: 2,000 EUR HT — 3 sessions (5-7h), diagnosis, installation, documentation
- Follow-up / Debug: 150 EUR HT/h
- Monthly Maintenance: 500 EUR HT/month
- Custom Agent Development: on quote

## Products & Pricing

### AI Agents (Shop)
- Bubble Sentinel (Security Agent): 29 EUR/month — Automated security audits for Claude Code. 5 modules, zero dependencies.
- Portfolio Manager: Coming soon — Risk parity, regime detection, auto-rebalancing.
- Community Manager: Coming soon — LinkedIn, Instagram, X automation with human validation.

- Individual stock analyses: 7.99-12.99 EUR each
- Scoring, investable theses, risk assessment

### Substack Newsletter
- Free tier: Regular articles on AI, investing, economics
- Paid tier: 8 USD/month — Early access to new articles
